name: surfingdog-inbox
description: Surfing Dog Inbox — an open-source, self-hostable typed inbox for businesses: messages, quotes, bookings and orders from people and AI agents.

INBOX_OWNER_EMAIL.description: Your email address. Only this address can sign in the first time.

INBOX_SECRET_KEY.description: A long random string: run `openssl rand -base64 32` and paste the result. Keep a copy somewhere safe. It locks stored secrets and signs receipts.

MAIL_FROM.description: The address your inbox emails from, like `inbox@yourdomain.com`. Its domain must be onboarded to [Email Sending](https://developers.cloudflare.com/email-service/get-started/send-emails/) on this account (Workers Paid). Leave it empty for now and your sign-in link is written to the Worker's logs.

DB.description: Your inbox's database: every booking, order and message.
